static_checks.message: Discovery may be scoped but batch ingest is not automatic
Email remains a reviewed proposal unless separately approved
Native qualification review requires an exact linked opportunity and read
Salesforce Next Steps uses the canonical read-preview-write-readback protocol
Local task proposal does not imply Google Tasks sync

patterns: does not save the local meeting
static_checks.message: Workspace note and workbook tab are distinct approved writes
Skill arguments must not be presented as CLI flags

evals.expected_behavior: Confirm the exact meeting and source, review extracted facts, and propose a follow-up and tasks without automatic writes.
assertions: Confirms the exact meeting rather than assuming the latest file belongs to it
Does not run account-unfiltered batch ingest automatically
Separates customer commitments from inference and marks unknown dates unknown
Shows the email for review without sending or creating a Gmail draft absent separate approval
Offers exact-question native qualification review only with an authorized live read
Proposes TASKS.md entries and a meeting note before asking to write either

evals.prompt: /post-meeting acme-corp/platform-modernization --quick --from-notes 'We agreed to schedule a demo next week.'
evals.expected_behavior: Use the supplied note to review facts and propose tasks only.
assertions: Does not invent an exact date, owner, or recipient
Proposes rather than silently writes task entries
Skips email, qualification review, and saved note

evals.expected_behavior: Omit email and leave unsupported or unapproved steps pending.
assertions: Does not draft or send email
Does not assign evidence to a ClosePlan question without a complete selected live deal
Shows a proposed note destination and asks before saving

evals.prompt: please send the follow-up email to the customer contact after the meeting
evals.expected_behavior: Prepare a reviewable draft but never send autonomously.
assertions: Requires separate approval and verified account and recipient before claiming an external Gmail draft exists
